steps.title: Victor Hale: enterprise succession interview · part 1
steps.detail: Victor Hale asks for an enterprise succession interview. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Victor Hale: enterprise succession interview · part 2
steps.detail: The enterprise succession interview now has conflicting notes. Victor Hale wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Victor Hale: enterprise succession interview · part 3
steps.detail: Victor Hale is ready to introduce a paying client for the enterprise succession interview. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented enterprise succession interview. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Victor Hale.
